ENTITLED: “AN ORDINANCE CREATING A NEW SECTION 12.04.240, LIENS, OF
CHAPTER12.04, STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND DRIVEWAYS
GENERALLY, OF TITLE 12, STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND PUBLIC
PLACES, OF THE CODE OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING"
CHEYENNE WYOMING:
Section 1.
That a new Section 12.04.240, Liens, of Chapter12.04, Streets, Sidewalks
and Driveways Generally, of Title12, Streets, Sidewalks and Public Places, ofthe code of the City
of Cheyenne, Wyoming, is hereby created as set out in this ordinance.
12.04.240
Liens.
Any lien against property pursuant to Chapter 12.04 shall be a priority lien, and shall have
priority over all other liens except prior tax or assessment liens.
Section2.That sections currently existing in Chapter12.04 not set out within this ordinance
remain unchanged.
Section 3. That this ordinance shall be in full force and effect upon its approval and
publication.
